design: Wondershot capture brackets and wonder spark with Bifrost spectrum rim
edit_prompt: Edit this Wondershot macOS icon concept. Preserve the exact overall composition, dark rounded-square tile, scale, generous transparent outside margins, four thick rounded cyan-teal capture brackets, and central white four-point spark. Add a restrained but clearly visible Bifrost rainbow accent: a fine continuous inlaid spectrum seam just inside the rounded-square tile perimeter, following its rounded corners, approximately 5 pixels thick at this resolution. Smooth spectrum transitions from warm red/orange on upper left through yellow/green along the upper edge into cyan/blue at upper right and purple/magenta toward the lower right, completing an elegant full spectrum perimeter. The seam looks precisely inlaid into the dark satin material, not a glowing neon halo. Keep it narrow and beautiful; most of the tile remains nearly black. Maintain crisp small-icon readability. Keep the main capture emblem cyan-teal and central spark white. No new symbols, no text, no extra frame, no rainbow-filled background, no bloom or glare. Preserve genuine alpha transparency outside the tile. One icon only, not a comparison sheet.
